question: 9 cm long perpendicular is drawn from the center of the circle to a 24 cm long chord. Find the radius of the circle.
solution:
Given: 

A 9-cm-long perpendicular is drawn from the circle's centre to a chord of length 24 cm.

Concept used:

The perpendicular drawn from the centre of the circle to the chord bisects the chord

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2c7b4cebd3cb4655968265a2f6c78ede87fa3f8389bdfd11702a8a953fde451.png] 

⇒ AM = MB = 24/2 = 12 cm

In Right triangle AMO,

AO² = OM2 + AM² = 9² + 12² = 225

⇒ AM² = 225

⇒ AM = 15 cm
